title: QuestCraft Essentials
description: QuestCraft Essentials is a lightweight Minecraft 1.21.5 modpack designed to improve VR performance on the Meta Quest 3/3s/2.
body:
![QuestCraft Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a70c93a47f9a25f35c23b2d7f31ea0392a7111c.png) # QuestCraft Essentials QuestCraft Essentials is an optimization modpack for Questcraft VR.

**Why Download The QuestCraft Essentials ModPack?** This modpack improves performance on all Quest (and Pico) devices, allowing for a smoother experience.
